summary: Cheer Holding, Inc. filed a Form 6-K, which is a report of a foreign private issuer, covering its semi-annual results for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes routine subsequent event disclosures about share increases and consolidations, but does not announce any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change. As a standard periodic report with no special-situation catalyst, this filing does not qualify for any special-situations category.
